clue.text: Nobody can recall being affected by it

definitions.text: Nobody can recall being affected by it

parts.words: Nobody can recall being affected by it
parts.note: read as a riddle: a condition whose sufferers by its very nature cannot remember having had it

explanation.surface: A mystery condition that leaves no trace in anyone's memory.
explanation.definitionFit: Loss of memory is the medical condition named, so its victims literally cannot recall it.

clue.text: A way a jerk is likely to move about

parts.note: ST, short for street, is a common abbreviation for a way or road
a tic is an involuntary twitch or jerk of a muscle

explanation.surface: A person with a twitch is bound to fidget around.
explanation.definitionFit: An astatic object is unstable, having no fixed position, so it tends to shift around.

clue.text: Wild lionesses not making a sound

indicators.note: wild suggests the letters of the next word run free and are scrambled

explanation.surface: Big cats in their natural habitat stalking prey in total silence.
explanation.definitionFit: Something silent produces no noise at all.

clue.text: Missile a woman will use

parts.note: she is the pronoun for a woman
'll is the contracted form of will, as in I'll

explanation.surface: A projectile weapon that a lady intends to employ.
explanation.walkthrough: SHE + 'LL reads as 'she will'; 'use' completes the surface as a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An artillery shell is an explosive projectile fired from a big gun.

clue.text: A rigid back

parts.note: stern means strict or rigid in manner

explanation.surface: A stiff spine.
explanation.definitionFit: Astern means towards the back of a ship, behind it.

clue.text: Record ring road contention

parts.note: a record is a disc, a vinyl LP
a ring is round, the shape of the letter O

explanation.surface: A dispute over a ring road scheme gets put on the record.
explanation.definitionFit: Contention is strife or disagreement, which is what discord means.

clue.text: Vessel the first mate left to get into a mess

parts.note: a dish is a vessel for holding food
Eve was Adam's partner, the first wife in the Bible

explanation.surface: The first officer quit the ship, leaving it in chaos.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first mate' suggests a ship's officer; here it is Eve, Adam's companion.
explanation.definitionFit: To dishevel is to make hair or clothes untidy and disordered.

clue.text: Among the best of building materials, one stands out

definitions.text: Among the best of building materials

indicators.note: out signals the letters are put out of place, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Praising one building material as clearly superior to the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: This sedimentary rock is a much-used, durable material for constructing walls and buildings.

clue.text: Best for a picnic?

explanation.surface: Asking what would be ideal for eating outdoors.
explanation.walkthrough: Split as OUT DO, an open-air party, which a picnic is; the question mark flags the playful second definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To best someone is to surpass them; and an outdoor 'do', a party held outside, describes a picnic.

clue.text: Increase the underworld has to watch

parts.note: Dis is the Roman god of the underworld, and the name of the underworld itself
to tend is to watch over or look after

explanation.surface: Hell sees a rise in numbers and must keep an eye on things.
explanation.definitionFit: To distend is to swell or enlarge, as a stomach expands.

clue.text: The main overseer should have this in hand

definitions.text: The main overseer should have this in hand

parts.words: The main overseer should have this in hand
parts.note: the main is the sea, and its overseer is the sea god Neptune, always pictured holding his three-pronged spear

explanation.surface: A chief supervisor is expected to keep a certain thing under control.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The main' looks like 'the chief', but in crosswords the main is the open sea, so the overseer is Neptune.
explanation.definitionFit: Neptune, ruler of the sea, carries a three-pronged spear as his emblem.

clue.text: Political bodies, tense as can be

indicators.note: the letters of the words that come before are shown as they can be rearranged, so they are mixed up

explanation.surface: Legislatures are described as being as tense as they possibly can be.
explanation.walkthrough: 'can be' rearranges TENSE and AS together.
explanation.definitionFit: Senates are legislative assemblies, a kind of governing body in politics.

clue.text: Kiss first — sweet talk afterwards

parts.note: Irish legend says that whoever kisses a certain stone at Blarney Castle near Cork is given the gift of smooth, flattering talk

explanation.surface: Advice on romance: start with a kiss and save the charming words for later.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a courtship sequence; in fact it describes the Irish castle tradition where kissing a stone brings eloquence.
explanation.definitionFit: Tradition holds that kissing this Irish castle stone grants the gift of the gab, meaning persuasive flattery.

clue.text: Top man causing a scare

indicators.note: the letters are made to produce, or cause, a new word by being rearranged

explanation.surface: The boss is the one who gives everyone a fright.
explanation.definitionFit: A Caesar was a Roman emperor, so the word stands for any supreme ruler or autocrat.

clue.text: Job-seeker put in charge in a phosphorus factory

parts.note: P is the chemical symbol for phosphorus

indicators.note: the second in means the letters for 'in charge' are placed inside the others

parts.note: a plant is an industrial factory
IC is the standard abbreviation for in charge, describing someone put in command

explanation.surface: Someone looking for work is made manager at a chemical works.
explanation.walkthrough: IC goes inside A P PLANT, signalled by the second 'in'.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who applies for a post is an applicant, a candidate for work.

clue.text: "Disgusted" was up in arms

explanation.surface: Someone sickened by events took up arms in protest.
explanation.definitionFit: Revolted means sickened or repelled, and also rose in rebellion against authority.

clue.text: End with the directors on the wagon

parts.note: the tail is the end of something
a company's directors form its board

explanation.surface: The company board's ending up teetotal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on the wagon' suggests abstaining from drink, but the definition is literal: the hinged back flap on a cart.
explanation.definitionFit: This hinged back panel is found on a cart or lorry, lowered for loading.

clue.text: Softly lit as promised

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical direction for softly
lit and lighted are both past forms of light

explanation.surface: A dimly lit room, as agreed.
explanation.definitionFit: To plight one's troth is to pledge, so plighted means pledged.

clue.text: Put letters down quite wrongly to dash after a girl

indicators.note: the piece for dash follows the piece for the girl in the answer

parts.note: Miss is the title of a young unmarried woman
to dash is to rush along, and to pelt also means to run fast

explanation.surface: Someone scribbles wildly in their haste to chase after a young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: To write letters in the wrong order is to make a spelling error.

clue.text: Beastly fighting man raising stick at a number

indicators.note: in a down clue, raising the letters means writing them from the bottom up, reading backwards

parts.note: a rod is a stick
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, a number

explanation.surface: A brutish warrior brandishes a club at a crowd.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raising' turns the whole run RODATAM upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A bullfighter fights beasts, the bulls, in the ring.

clue.text: Serving men willingly give assistance

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a corps of serving soldiers in the British Army
lief is an old word meaning gladly or willingly, as in 'I would as lief stay'

explanation.surface: Soldiers on duty are glad to lend a hand.
explanation.walkthrough: LIEF is archaic for 'gladly'; 'give' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Relief is help given to those in need, such as aid after a disaster.

clue.text: As to support, hold back

parts.note: for can mean as regards or as to, as in 'for my part'
to bear is to support a weight

explanation.surface: When it comes to backing someone, show restraint.
explanation.definitionFit: To forbear is to refrain from doing something, to restrain oneself.

clue.text: Wins over church members

parts.note: arms are limbs, members of the body

explanation.surface: A congregation is won over.
explanation.definitionFit: To charm someone is to win their favour by being delightful.

clue.text: Racing bets — those made to provide sport

indicators.note: the letters are made, or formed, into something new by rearrangement

explanation.surface: Wagers placed at the racecourse are what make the sport worth watching.
explanation.walkthrough: 'made' rearranges RACING BETS THOSE; the sport is a Scottish Highland Games event where a long pole is thrown end over end.
explanation.definitionFit: Hurling a tree trunk end over end is a traditional Scottish athletic contest at Highland Games.

clue.text: The head of state is a sovereign showing fibre

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter

parts.note: a sovereign was a pound coin, and L is the abbreviation for pound (from Latin libra)

explanation.surface: The head of state, a monarch, displays fine strands.
explanation.walkthrough: A sovereign is an old British gold coin worth one pound; 'showing' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Sisal is a plant whose leaves yield strong strands used to make rope and twine.

clue.text: Breed some find practical — very useful

indicators.note: some means only part of the following words is taken, the letters lying within them

explanation.surface: Someone reckons a certain thing is practical and extremely handy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'some' takes the run across practiCAL VEry; 'find' and 'useful' fill out the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: To calve is to give birth to a calf, as cows breed.

clue.text: Far from cool

explanation.surface: Something a long way from cold.
explanation.definitionFit: Distant means far away in space, and also aloof or unfriendly in manner.

clue.text: When about 50 relax — let go

parts.note: re is a Latin word meaning about or concerning, used in letters
L is the Roman numeral for fifty
to relax is to ease off

explanation.surface: Someone told to take it easy once they reach their fifties.
explanation.definitionFit: To free something from one's grip is to let it go.

clue.text: Treadle replacement being connected

indicators.note: the letters are replaced or moved into new positions, a rearrangement

explanation.surface: Fitting a new foot pedal to a sewing machine and getting it attached.
explanation.walkthrough: 'replacement' rearranges TREADLE; a treadle is a foot pedal that drives a machine.
explanation.definitionFit: Things that are connected are linked or associated with one another.

clue.text: Bearing with the individual supplying the money, and that's fine

parts.note: S, south, is a compass bearing
a person who provides a loan is a lender

explanation.surface: A loan arrives with the person putting up the cash, and everything is settled.
explanation.definitionFit: Fine can mean thin or delicate, the same as slim and narrow.
